comment: Manual corrections applied by scripts/build-transit-network.mjs after the automatic matching. Renames run first, so a rename can also enable a merge.
//move: stop id -> [lat, lon] replacing the export's coordinate: surveyed corrections, operator route changes, and OSM positions for legacy stops the export never carried.
//keepSeparate: groups of stop ids that share a name but are separate kerbs, closer together than the pole-merge radius. Each keeps its own marker.
//mergeInto: stop id -> stop id it should be drawn as; lines are combined onto the target.
//addStops: route id -> stop ids the export omits. Each is slotted in at the position its geometry implies.
//moveLines: reassigns line badges the automatic name+distance matching attached to the wrong pole of a same-named pair. Only needed for a line whose stop list has no route to speak for it.
